The charcoal will only be helpful while in the body, and depending on the amount of toxins, it may not be helpful enough.

Weapon_98k_Karabiner.name: Kar98
Weapon_98k_Karabiner.description: Kar98 is a bolt-action rifle. Although supplemented by semi- and fully automatic rifles during World War II, it remained the primary rifle until the end of the war in 1945. The Kar98 continues to appear in conflicts across the world as they are taken out of storage during times of strife. Uses 7.92x57mm ammunition.

Weapon_AT4_HEAT.name: AT4 HEAT
Weapon_AT4_HEAT.description: AT-4 is a single-shot 84mm shoulder fired recoilless launcher. It is a modern solution for a light, disposable, man-portable, anti armored, and anti fortifications launcher. It is effective against light armored vehicles but will be useless against any heavy armor/fortifications. High-explosive anti-tank (HEAT) warhead carries a shaped charge explosive meant to penetrate armor, but is less effective in a wide area.

Weapon_BayRifferBlock21.name: Bay Riffer Block21
Weapon_BayRifferBlock21.description: The Block 21 is a full-size service pistol, a standard law enforcement round with proven knock down power. Painted with Bay Riffer colors. Uses: 0.45 ACP ammunition.

Weapon_DEagle_50.description: The DEagle 50 is a semi-automatic handgun notable for chambering the largest centerfire cartridge of any magazine-fed, self-loading pistol. Uses: .50 AE ammunition.

Weapon_DT11B.name: DT11B
Weapon_DT11B.description: Double barrel, single trigger shotgun with over-and-under configuration. Uses 12 gauge ammunition.

Weapon_DT11B_Sawed_Off.name: "The Mule" DT11B short
Weapon_DT11B_Sawed_Off.description: Double barrel, single trigger shotgun with over-and-under configuration. This is sawed-off version, compact but less accurate, kicks like a mule. Uses 12 gauge ammunition.

Weapon_FlareGun.description: A flare gun is a handheld firearm designed to launch signal flares. It is used to create illumination for improved vision or as a distress signal. Uses flare cartridges as ammunition.
